description: PSO error standard (RFC 9457) catalog: the single contract shared by the TypeScript orchestrator and the Java starters. Each runtime tests its own catalog against this file.

kinds.title: Bad request
kinds.detail: The request could not be understood.

kinds.title: Validation failed
kinds.detail: The request is not valid; see the errors member.

kinds.title: Malformed JSON body
kinds.detail: The request body is not valid JSON.

kinds.title: Malformed multipart body
kinds.detail: The multipart/form-data body is malformed.

kinds.title: Request aborted
kinds.detail: The client closed the request before it was complete.

kinds.title: Authentication required
kinds.detail: Valid credentials are required to access this resource.

kinds.title: Access denied
kinds.detail: The authenticated caller is not allowed to perform this operation.

kinds.title: Resource not found
kinds.detail: No resource matches the request.

kinds.title: Conflict
kinds.detail: The request conflicts with the current state of the resource.

kinds.title: Resource not found
kinds.detail: A resource this request depends on does not exist in an upstream service.

kinds.title: Conflict
kinds.detail: An upstream service refused the operation because it conflicts with the current state of a resource.

kinds.title: Request body too large
kinds.detail: The request body exceeds the configured limit.

kinds.title: File too large
kinds.detail: An uploaded file exceeds the allowed size.

kinds.title: Method not allowed
kinds.detail: The HTTP method is not supported for this resource.

kinds.title: Multipart not enabled
kinds.detail: Multipart requests are not enabled for this service.

kinds.title: Unsupported media type
kinds.detail: The request content type is not supported; use application/json.

kinds.title: Request headers too large
kinds.detail: The request headers exceed the configured limit.

kinds.title: Too many requests
kinds.detail: The rate limit was exceeded; retry after the interval given in Retry-After.

kinds.title: Internal error
kinds.detail: The server could not complete the request.

kinds.title: Upstream call refused by policy
kinds.detail: The outbound call was refused by the destination policy; nothing was sent.

kinds.title: Bad gateway
kinds.detail: An upstream service returned an invalid response.

kinds.title: Upstream rejected the request
kinds.detail: An upstream service refused a request this service made to complete the operation.

kinds.title: Upstream TLS failure
kinds.detail: The TLS connection to an upstream service could not be established or verified.

kinds.title: Upstream response too large
kinds.detail: An upstream service returned a response larger than the configured limit.

kinds.title: Upstream not configured
kinds.detail: The route refers to an upstream service that is not configured.

kinds.title: Upstream unavailable
kinds.detail: An upstream service could not be reached.

kinds.title: Storage unavailable
kinds.detail: The file storage backend could not complete the operation.

kinds.title: Server busy
kinds.detail: The server is at its concurrency limit; retry shortly.

kinds.title: Rate limiting unavailable
kinds.detail: The shared rate limit backend is unavailable and the policy is to refuse requests.

kinds.title: Upstream timeout
kinds.detail: An upstream service did not answer in time.
